A final technical report closes award DE-EE0009334 for PVpallet, Inc., covering May 2021 through December 2025. Philip Schwarz, the firm's co-founder and chief executive, is the named lead. Solar farms ship panels on single-use wood pallets that pile up as waste and let panels get damaged. The project built a reusable pallet from recycled, recyclable heavy-duty plastic, updating its Series X design for the older M6 panel size. The new Series U design targets the larger M10 panels now taking over big projects.

The redesign is modular, so one pallet family fits both farm-scale and home-scale panels. Engineers drew full CAD models and checked strength with computer stress analysis under working loads. Design reviews with industry users confirmed the brief was met. Goals included longer life, easier handling on site, and lower lifetime cost per panel shipped.
